title: Colpey Calling x The Fix [6]
content:
1 May 2015

This week we welcomed Bristol boss Nick Young with an hour long mix of everything from hip hop to house. Kicking things off, however, Colpey Calling treated us to an all-vinyl collection of treats. 

Tracklist

Colpey Calling

  • DJ Sotofett & Jaakko Eino Kalevi – ‘Ibiza Dub’
  • Sade – ‘Smooth Operator’
  • Tito Wun & Lorenzo – ‘Blessed By Tambourine’
  • Fulgeance & DJ Scientist – ‘From Lithuania With Love / ИзЛитвы С Любовью’
  • Gil Scott Heron & Brian Jackson – ‘We Almost Lost Detroit’
  • Jethro Tull – ‘Living in the Past’
  • Joni Mitchell – ‘The Jungle Line’
  • Emanative – ‘Naima’
  • Arsenii – ‘Miss Holy Holy’
  • Norma Jean Bell – ‘I’m the Baddest Bitch’ (Moodymann Remix)
  • Paper Music – Theme From Salt City Orchestra
  • American Steel – ‘Hustling Time’
  • United Future Organization – ‘Moon Dance’
  • Gregory Porter – ‘Liquid Spirit’ (Patchwork Peterson Remix)
